# TRL-PARSE-0014: Mapping selects more than one alternative

- Severity: error
- Exit class: error
- Area: PARSE
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active

## Remediation

Keep exactly one selecting key, such as one step keyword or one pipeline shape.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-PARSE-0014", "severity": "error", "params": {"keys": "<keys>"}}
```
